# Astron Technology

> Astron Technology delivers comprehensive enterprise IT solutions spanning cloud infrastructure, workplace management, security services, and software licensing with managed support.

Astron Technology is an Australian IT services provider specializing in cloud solutions, endpoint management, infrastructure services, and enterprise licensing. The company offers integrated solutions across workplace transformation, security operations, and IT lifecycle management.

## Key Topics

- Endpoint as a Service (EaaS)
- Cloud Infrastructure (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
- Disaster Recovery as a Service (DRaaS)
- Managed Services
- Microsoft Cloud Solution Provider (CSP)
- Security Operations Center (SOC)
- Hybrid IT
- Backup as a Service (BaaS)
- Unified Communications
- Asset Lifecycle Management
- Incident Response
- Device Management
- Enterprise Licensing
- Workplace Solutions
- Storage as a Service (STaaS)

## Workplace Solutions

- [Workplace](https://astrontech.com.au/workplace): Workplace solutions including EaaS and unified communications management
- [Workplace Solutions](https://astrontech.com.au/workplace-solutions): Endpoint as a Service and workplace transformation solutions overview
- [Endpoint as a Service](https://astrontech.com.au/endpoint-as-a-service): EaaS product offering for device management and enterprise solutions
- [Asset Lifecycle](https://astrontech.com.au/asset-lifecycle): Asset lifecycle management with unified communications and print solutions

## Cloud & Infrastructure

- [Cloud](https://astrontech.com.au/cloud): Cloud solutions including IaaS, DRaaS, BaaS and STaaS offerings
- [Infrastructure](https://astrontech.com.au/infrastructure): Infrastructure solutions covering AWS, Azure, Google Cloud and hybrid IT
- [Server Storage](https://astrontech.com.au/server-storage): Server storage with AI-enabled network protection and disaster recovery
- [Networking](https://astrontech.com.au/networking): Networking solutions with core-to-edge management and security services

## Security Services

- [Assess & Safeguard](https://astrontech.com.au/assess-safeguard): Security assessment with ISO 27001 compliance and penetration testing services
- [Monitor & Prevent](https://astrontech.com.au/monitor-prevent): Security monitoring with SOC, IPS and multi-factor authentication solutions
- [Respond & Recover](https://astrontech.com.au/respond-recover): Incident response and disaster recovery with forensic investigation services

## Managed Services

- [Services](https://astrontech.com.au/services): Managed IT services including block hours and cloud infrastructure solutions
- [Managed Services](https://astrontech.com.au/managed-services): Managed services covering EaaS, IaaS, DRaaS and endpoint support
- [Professional Service](https://astrontech.com.au/professional-service): Professional services for cloud solutions and technology strategy consulting

## Licensing & Compliance

- [Microsoft](https://astrontech.com.au/microsoft_Licensing): Microsoft Cloud Solution Provider licensing and CSP portal management
- [Enterprise & Cloud Licensing](https://astrontech.com.au/enterprise_cloud_licensing): Enterprise and cloud licensing with Microsoft CSP and compliance management
- [Renewals](https://astrontech.com.au/renewals): Software renewals and license management for Microsoft and enterprise solutions

## Optional

- [Sustainability Solutions](https://astrontech.com.au/services/sustainability-solutions): ESG and sustainability solutions with e-waste recycling and IT lifecycle management
